{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the presence of -1 values in customer_age
missing_age_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
df_filtered = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of the remaining customers
mean_age = df_filtered['customer_age'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f'Mean age of customers (excluding -1 values): {mean_age:.2f} years')"}
